تناظرت (form VI)
# تَنَاظَرْتُ (tanāẓartu) /ta.naː.ðˤar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاظَرَ (tanāẓara)
# تَنَاظَرْتَ (tanāẓarta) /ta.naː.ðˤar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاظَرَ (tanāẓara)
# تَنَاظَرْتِ (tanāẓarti) /ta.naː.ðˤar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاظَرَ (tanāẓara)
# تَنَاظَرَتْ (tanāẓarat) /ta.naː.ðˤa.rat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
